Name: Dark red farmhouse with flower boxes
Author: AnticAssassin
Description:
[color=Red]Hellow fellow gamers,[/color]

I made a new texture for the farm house. It'll change the house to be dark red with a grey roof. I also changed the windows a little bit. Plus I added flower boxes cause who doesn't like flowers? Will work for every house upgrade.

How to install:

1) Make sure you have a backup of your original "Content" folder
2) Download and unzip the file
3) Put the "houses.xnb" in your [b][color=Red]...\Stardew Valley\Content\Buildings[/color][/b] folder, [b]overwriting[/b] the original file
4) Start your game and enjoy!




Take a look at my other mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1335/?]A different outfit for Shane[/url]

Visit me on tumblr for updates: [url=http://slothssassin.tumblr.com/]AnticAssassin's tumblr[/url]

Downloads.Description: Changes the look of your farmhouse. The house will be dark red with a grey roof. Also it will add flower boxes to your windows.
